law003_navt_transport_operator_law.name: NavT Transport Operator Law
law003_navt_transport_operator_law.purpose: Define a first explicit law-program candidate for NavT as bounded orientation-sensitive transport.

candidate_law_statement.informal: Given local orientation state omega_alpha and related orientation state omega_beta inside CSI(alpha), NavT returns a transport contribution from beta to alpha, weighted by orientation compatibility, admissibility context, and bounded nonlocal decay.
candidate_law_statement.law001_embedding: δ(E_α > 0) uses Π_{A_α}(T_α) as the projected admissible continuation contribution.
candidate_law_statement.noninvertibility_condition: NavT^{-1} is not assumed to exist; multiple preimage transport configurations may yield observationally equivalent T_α.
candidate_law_statement.finite_flux_condition: Σ_{β∈CSI(α)} ||NavT(ω_α,ω_β)|| < ∞ under declared CSI weighting conditions.
candidate_law_statement.important_note: This is a candidate transport law, not a proof of physical transport, invertibility, convergence under all CSI domains, or global closure.
